Hana (Finance): Morning — noticed two invoices for Nimbus Corp from last night's run. One missing the reserved_capacity discount (-$2,400).
Eli (Billing): Invoice numbers 2026-04-NB-0029 and 2026-04-NB-0029-dup. Totals: $12,400 vs $10,000.
InvoiceBot: job=invoice.batch run=1794123200 status=partial_fail duplicates=1 missing_lines=1
Samir (Billing-ops): We had an upstream schema change in the usage exporter that added a new field and some rows landed with null "contract_type". The discount rows use contract_type to tag credits.
Priya (Engineering): Reproduced locally. Quick fix: default contract_type to "reserved" when null for historical rows. I'll push hotfix to recompose endpoint.
Eli (Billing): Can we recompose only Nimbus? Don't want to rerun full batch.
Priya (Engineering): Using POST /internal/billing/recompose?account=nimbus&run=1794123200 — run started.
InvoiceBot: recompose job=1794127800 status=success artifact=/tmp/nimbus_recompose_1794127800.csv
Eli (Billing): Replaced dup with 2026-04-NB-0029-R1, voided duplicate. Drafted credit memo for $2,400.
Hana (Finance): Approved credit memo. Ava (Acct Exec) OK'd message to customer.
Samir (Billing-ops): Adding guard: exporter must set contract_type or recompose will fail with non-destructive warning. Also adding unit test for null contract_type case.
Priya (Engineering): Patch merged. Monitoring alert added for duplicate invoice_id > 0.
Hana (Finance): Customer notified, credit memo sent. Closing unless we see other affected accounts.
_meta: generated_for_dataset: finance invoice generation failures; notes: short thread, bot logs, targeted recompose
